title: ForeFlight Route Briefing Lag
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flight:log aircraft_type=* route_built_epoch=* briefing_complete_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((briefing_complete_epoch-route_built_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by aircraft_type
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures route-briefing lag by aircraft type for route briefings.
value: Lag tracking shows which aircraft type create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside route briefings.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `route-briefing lag` on `flight:log` events and aggregate them by `aircraft_type`.
visualization: Table of aircraft type with average and worst route-briefing lag.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how long things take for each aircraft type so you can see where route briefings slows down.
